top.description: Player 1 background (Marty + Doc). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
top.prompt: A cinematic, highly detailed 1980s movie still of a single unified scene at a shopping mall parking lot at night, 1:1 square aspect ratio. On the far left, a teenage boy with feathered brown hair, wearing a red puffy down vest over a blue denim jacket and a checkered shirt, is standing holding a pink futuristic hoverboard under his arm, looking back in awe. On the far right, an eccentric elderly scientist with wild, messy white hair and a white radiation suit with yellow accents stands holding a black remote control with a long antenna. A retro-futuristic silver brushed-steel gull-wing sports car is parked in the distant background, emitting a soft blue electrical plasma aura. The entire middle-center area of the dark asphalt parking lot is completely clean, empty, and free of objects, with dry ice fog drifting across. Dramatic high-contrast theatrical lighting, neon blue and orange highlight reflections, film grain, photorealistic cinematic style. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

bottom.description: Player 2 background (Dystopian Biff 1985-A). Formato cuadrado 1:1, caos a los lados, centro abierto.

loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Marty y Doc jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic en el garaje. Vertical 9:16 mobile.

The teenage boy is looking intensely focused and amazed, holding his cards which show brown card backs featuring a central oval and five colored circles. The scientist, with wild white hair and wide, crazy eyes, is enthusiastically holding his hand of cards and pointing at a card on the table as if explaining a complex card combo. On the workbench between them, a correct card game battlefield is laid out: rows of black-bordered cards, with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degrees showing they are tapped, next to electronic parts and tools. In the background, a silver brushed-steel gull-wing sports car is parked, emitting a soft neon blue glow. Warm ambient garage lighting, cinematic film grain, detailed faces. --ar 9:16 --no poker cards, standard playing cards, text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons
